_about: Public object-storage (bucket) providers, for Unit 4 bucket discovery. Each provider has host patterns that identify a bucket endpoint and capture the bucket or storage-account name (the named group 'bucket' or 'account'), the short service name that prefixes the stored StorageBucket's unique_id (service, e.g. s3:<bucket>), the probe endpoint template to check existence (placeholders {host} and {bucket}), the HTTP method, the response signature of a missing bucket (not_found: a deleted or never-claimed bucket, the subdomain-takeover case) and of a world-readable listing (public_listing), and the vendor's own documentation in source. This drives observed-name mining (CNAME and cert-SAN hosts already stored), a light active existence + listing probe (active mode only, paced, in-scope, never listing or fetching objects), and the dangling lens's bucket-takeover confirmation. Attribution is ownership-gated: a bucket is surfaced only when it is reached from an in-scope asset, never from a guessed name. Add providers here, not in Go code. A genuinely new response shape may need the probe parser extended.
